purpose: Declare one test per AC of US-19002 (FBS-220) driving rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> through bin/rcf.js, so the FBS-220 Define round turns each declaration into a red test against the report-ingesting Finalise.
title: Administrative Finalise: rcf build finalise --ci-run ingests the Test-stage report and promotes to verified, refuses missing, uncontained, loopback, stale, non-separate or blocking reports, retires --mode and --url, spawns nothing

testCases.description: rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> with a valid verifier PASS report exits 0, sets executionStatus verified and prints "finalise: <fbs-id> verified from <report path> (head <sha7>, ci <ref>)", spawning nothing but git
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/administrative-finalise.test.js::AC-19002-1: rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> with a valid verifier PASS report exits 0, sets executionStatus verified and prints "finalise: <fbs-id> verified from <report path> (head <sha7>, ci <ref>)", spawning nothing but git

testCases.description: rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> with no report exits 4 with "finalise refused: no Test-stage verify report for <fbs-id>; the verifier runs rcf verify run --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier before merge" and the FBS stays complete
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/administrative-finalise.test.js::AC-19002-2: rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --ci-run <ref> with no report exits 4 with "finalise refused: no Test-stage verify report for <fbs-id>; the verifier runs rcf verify run --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier before merge" and the FBS stays complete

testCases.description: rcf build finalise exits 4 with "finalise refused: report head <sha7> is not contained in HEAD <sha7>; re-verify the merged head", "report target <url> is loopback" or "report is <n> days old"
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/administrative-finalise.test.js::AC-19002-3: rcf build finalise exits 4 with "finalise refused: report head <sha7> is not contained in HEAD <sha7>; re-verify the merged head", "report target <url> is loopback" or "report is <n> days old"

testCases.description: rcf build finalise on a report whose hand is not verifier or whose verifierId matches a builder Hand-Id exits 4 with "finalise refused: report hand <hand>/<id> is not separate from the builder" and the FBS is unchanged
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/administrative-finalise.test.js::AC-19002-4: rcf build finalise on a report whose hand is not verifier or whose verifierId matches a builder Hand-Id exits 4 with "finalise refused: report hand <hand>/<id> is not separate from the builder" and the FBS is unchanged

testCases.description: rcf build finalise exits 4 "ci evidence missing: pass --ci-run <ref>", 4 not-complete, 4 off-trunk and 3 "missing Code Nodes: <ac-ids>"; a report failing VerifyReport v1 exits 3 naming the field
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/administrative-finalise.test.js::AC-19002-5: rcf build finalise exits 4 "ci evidence missing: pass --ci-run <ref>", 4 not-complete, 4 off-trunk and 3 "missing Code Nodes: <ac-ids>"; a report failing VerifyReport v1 exits 3 naming the field

testCases.description: rcf build finalise on a report carrying MOCK-ONLY-DECLARED, EVAL-MISSING, EVAL-BELOW-THRESHOLD, UI-BASELINE-UNMET, BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING or SCOPE-MISMATCH, or a non-PASS or non-ship verdict, exits 4 with the 0.20.0 and 0.28.0 message shapes
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/administrative-finalise.test.js::AC-19002-6: rcf build finalise on a report carrying MOCK-ONLY-DECLARED, EVAL-MISSING, EVAL-BELOW-THRESHOLD, UI-BASELINE-UNMET, BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING or SCOPE-MISMATCH, or a non-PASS or non-ship verdict, exits 4 with the 0.20.0 and 0.28.0 message shapes

testCases.description: rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --mode <any> or --url <url> exits 2 with "finalise no longer runs verify; run rcf verify run --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier at the Test stage" and spawns nothing
testCases.testPointer: test/finalise/administrative-finalise.test.js::AC-19002-7: rcf build finalise <fbs-id> --mode <any> or --url <url> exits 2 with "finalise no longer runs verify; run rcf verify run --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier at the Test stage" and spawns nothing

testCases.description: rcf build finalise never spawns rcf verify run, the verifier package or the agent CLI, and every refusal leaves rcf/fbs/<fbs-id>.json byte-identical
